name: Baked Sea Bass with Lemon Potatoes and Fennel

components.name: Baked Sea Bass

ingredients.name: Raw boneless sea bass fillets (rather than whole fish)

steps: Pat sea bass dry and season with salt, olive oil and basil. Place skin down on a separate tray or on top of nearly finished potatoes.
Roast fish 10-15 minutes until the thickest centre reaches 63 C; do not leave in oven while potatoes finish.
Portion sea bass, lemon potatoes and fennel into four substantial meals; keep any fresh herbs separate.

components.name: Lemon Potatoes & Fennel
steps: Preheat oven to 210 C. Toss halved potatoes, fennel and onion with oil, lemon, garlic, oregano and salt on a large tray.
Roast 25-35 minutes, turning once, until potatoes are almost tender and browned.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Good Food source uses whole sea bass and fennel; UNHANGRY uses boneless fillets and adds measured lemon potatoes.
Planning: OVEN ONLY, stagger fish after potatoes.
Freezer: cooked sea bass best fresh/early week; potatoes become softer when frozen
Dietary: Contains fish, possible small pin bones.

Refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers at 4°C or colder, for 3–4 days at most, and follow the shorter seafood limit above. Cook fish and shellfish to 63°C and reheat leftovers to at least 74°C.
